confirmed: Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendix A, and checked the recorded numbers against the local PDF. The PDF has 19 pages and is arXiv:2502.16097v1 [cs.HC], dated 22 Feb 2025, with CHI 2025 formatting and DOI 10.1145/3706598.3714111 (PDF p. 1; Appendix A, p. 19).
The title and six authors, in the order recorded by the form, match the title page and ACM reference (PDF p. 1).

No randomized people study is documented. The four task-system orders are enumerated, but random allocation to those orders is not stated; the explicit randomized order is the order in which E1 rated outputs (PDF pp. 10-11, Sections 5.2-5.3). The false checker flag means no confirmed randomized study, not proof that allocation was nonrandom.

Experiment I analyzed 16 students, the same people in both conditions; arm counts of 16 must not be summed as independent people. No randomized count or exclusions are reported, and the stated analysis sample is 16 (PDF p. 10, Section 5.1; p. 11, Table 2 and Sections 5.2-5.3; p. 12, Section 5.4).

The sample includes 11 graduate students in education-related fields and five CS-related students, including two undergraduates and three graduate students; mean age 23.44 and SD 2.24 are printed (PDF pp. 10-11, Section 5.1 and Table 2).

The core exclusion for fewer than 50 analyzed people is correct. The form correctly leaves random assignment unclear and records output scoring as met; context_class=none is retained for this small experiment with unresolved assignment, rather than inferring an observational allocation method (PDF pp. 10-12, Sections 5.1-5.4).

LitLinker uses GLM-4, and the baseline chatbot uses the same Zhipu model; this is an AI-configuration comparison with optional Google and Word in both conditions (PDF p. 8, Section 4.2.1; pp. 10-11, Section 5.2.1).
Participants planned sixth-grade Chinese-language lessons using at least three of eight readings, with 30 minutes per task and approximately 90 minutes per participant (PDF p. 11, Section 5.2.3).

One experienced teacher, E1, rated lesson-plan quality blind to condition on a seven-point scale, with seven outcome aspects shown in Figure 4; these are output ratings, not the self-reported Creativity Support Index (PDF p. 11, Section 5.3; p. 12, Figure 4 and RQ3 measurements).
Subject Integration exactly matches: LitLinker M=4.63, Mdn=6, SD=2.26; baseline M=3.56, Mdn=3, SD=2.00; p=0.34, r=0.50 (PDF p. 12, Section 5.4.1).
Completion exactly matches: LitLinker M=5.56, Mdn=6, SD=0.61; baseline M=4.19, Mdn=4.5, SD=2.01; p=0.02, Wilcoxon effect size r=0.93 (PDF p. 12, Section 5.4.1).
Content Alignment exactly matches: LitLinker M=4.25, Mdn=5, SD=2.80; baseline M=5.69, Mdn=7, SD=2.23; p=0.22, r=0.57 (PDF p. 12, Section 5.4.1).

Every number and direction in one_line_finding matches the PDF. Only Completion among the listed output outcomes has p<0.05; the form correctly avoids the paper prose's claim of significant baseline advantages despite its larger printed p-values (PDF p. 12, Section 5.4.1 and Figure 4).

The final-system expert-interview sample is reported as nine teachers, E1-E5 and E8-E11; the introduction inconsistently says 10, already noted in the form. The qualitative study does not provide a randomized comparison or quantitative output-score estimate (PDF pp. 1-2; p. 13, Sections 6-6.1; p. 14, Sections 6.2-6.3).
Experiment II tasks use 4-15 readings and two contexts; offline exploration lasts 30 minutes, while E1-E5 had three days of free use (PDF p. 14, Section 6.2).
The supplementary prompt specifications are referred to on p. 9, Section 4.2.3; Appendix A with interview questions is included on p. 19. The separate supplement is not included in this PDF.

This is an original system evaluation, not a synthesis; the empty synthesis fields are appropriate. No across-person diversity or post-AI-removal outcome is reported (PDF pp. 10-15, Sections 5-6; Appendix A, p. 19).
summary: The comparison analyzes 16 students with expert-rated lesson plans, but random assignment is not documented, so lab_rct is unsupported and the core sample-size threshold is not met. The recorded result strings and one-line finding match the PDF, while four outcome entries, formative-sample details, and source metadata require correction.
